summary: Comprehensive testing of two bug fixes: (1) Daily Brief generation - DailyBrief.js now correctly calls POST /api/generate-brief instead of non-existent POST /api/daily-brief. (2) Hard filter now rejects sports/entertainment in BOTH title AND content, with word-boundary matching for short keywords (ipl, odi, t20) to avoid false positives like 'Modi'. All 20 backend tests passed. Frontend Dashboard, Daily Brief, and Intelligence Feed all working correctly.
